name: callimachus
description: Recall your past AI coding sessions from a local index: the recall skill, the Callimachus MCP server, and hooks that inject each repo's memory when a Codex session starts, snapshot the session before compaction and queue it for distillation when it ends.

interface.shortDescription: Memory from your past AI coding sessions
interface.longDescription: Search and recall your Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent sessions from a local index, check a plan against earlier decisions, and give each new Codex session its repo's memory. Everything stays on your machine.
